raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "submit"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the heating assistance file"
  role location "Primăria din Năsăud"
  role time "November"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "receive"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "anything"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be cold"
  role subject "the house"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?t
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "receive"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "a response to the heating assistance file"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
